exposure: Infants with ACS administration-to-birth interval <48 hours
Infants with ACS administration-to-birth interval >48 hours
cohort: Very preterm infants born at Santa Clara Valley Medical Center between January 2008 and April 2014
finding: In very preterm infants, an antenatal corticosteroid administration-to-birth interval of >48 hours was associated with significant reductions in mortality, retinopathy of prematurity, intubation, and higher 1-minute Apgar scores compared to an interval of <48 hours.
